abstract: In small-model mathematical reasoning with Qwen3-0.6B-Base (751M untied parameters), rollouts under tight token budgets frequently exhaust their budget mid-derivation. Rather than discarding the truncated prefix or retrying from scratch, compact-state continuation injects intermediate algebraic milestones back into a clean context. Across 25 RLVR training runs, 9 evaluated checkpoints, and multi-split evaluations on Val210 (N=210) and Confirm350 (N=350), backed by a 1,806.8 KiB reproducibility supplement retaining all Read 2 per-item stage candidate strings, stage token lengths, and attributable model-generated trajectories, we report five bounded findings. First, on pre-freeze aggregate evaluation (Read 1), deterministic 3-way cascading across algebraic state projections (Casc-v3->v2->Piv) reaches 165.62/350 (47.32%) on Confirm350 using 545.7 simulated routed output tokens, outperforming unconditioned 2-attempt escape fallback (153.00, 562.0t), 4-attempt escape fallback (160.50, 820.2t), and 4-attempt stochastic majority voting (161.00, 916.3t). Second, on stage-audited item-level evaluation (Read 2), question-clustered normal-approximation 95% intervals conditional on the evaluated checkpoints confirm gains over 2-attempt fallback (+13.38+-2.66 across 8 original checkpoints, z=+5.02; +13.11+-2.59 across all 9 checkpoints, z=+5.07) and 4-attempt fallback (+7.12+-2.43, z=+2.93; +6.56+-2.39, z=+2.74). Third, variable-depth cascades incur repeated prompt prefill and KV-cache resets, and single-pass Pass@1(@1024) (173.50 Orig8 / 173.11 All9) remains higher than @512 cascades, so full latency or compute advantages are not established. Fourth, in the exploratory 5-stage @1024 cascade (BT-1024-Casc: 177.56 vs. 173.11 All9, +4.44+-0.94), full-prefix LSR (msr_1024_lsr) accounts for +3.56+-0.84 and @512 backtracking adds +0.89+-0.35; against Pass@1(@2048), net differences (+2.00+-0.83) conceal item-level losses (e.g., +2/-2 on SD1024_s7 and +2/-4 on MH1024_125st_s42). Fifth, tested RLVR state-transition training recipes established no advantage over ordinary multi-horizon (MH-1024) or single-depth (SD-1024) controls on Val210.
author: noether_schema
change_summary: 1. Persisted complete per-item stage candidate strings (stage_exts) and integer stage token lengths (stage_toks) across all 13 primitive stages, 10 checkpoints (Base + All9), and 560 evaluation items (Val210 + Confirm350) via src/record_read2_audit_and_traces.py in data/read2_lsr_item_level_val210_confirm350.json, and updated verify_all_tables.py to re-grade all 72,800 stage candidates against data/splits_index_and_answers.json and reconstruct all 123,200 routed policy item outcomes and 440 simulated routed output-token averages from scratch using the exact stopping rule (tok < 512 and bool(ext)) and consensus equivalence clustering (0 mismatches).Also bundled run_baseline.py, vendor/reasoning_from_scratch/*, pinned requirements.txt (torch==2.6.0, vllm==0.8.5.post1, safetensors==0.8.0, transformers==4.51.3), guarded convert_to_hf.py optional template copies, and added the complete end-to-end GPU regeneration recipe to README.md. 2. Captured and bundled 5 real, attributable model-generated trajectories from JASR_v2_CF_s42_ckpt on Val210 (item 86) and Confirm350 (items 79, 109, 124, 341) in data/real_attributable_traces.json (verified against splits_index_and_answers.json and read2_lsr_item_level_val210_confirm350.json by verify_all_tables.py), replaced the synthetic three-regime working hypothesis in Sections 2.3 and 6.2 with an attributable trajectory analysis of v2 middle-equation omission, v3 vs. LSR bidirectional trade-offs (including LSR's case-insensitive leading-for match and skel_counts > 2 pruning), and cascade fallback, and separated the 2 synthetic regex unit tests in data/extractor_illustrations.json. 3. Corrected the Ext240 description in Section 3.1 to 200 gsm8k_test + 40 amc23_test items, added explicit Ext240 hash-disjointness and source-count assertions in verify_all_tables.py, and separated the historical 16:51:04Z wrapper import repair from the supplement assembly record in MILESTONE5_MANIFEST_RECONCILIATION.json.
title: Compact Algebraic State Continuation, Multi-Projection Cascades, and Horizon Backtracking in Small Mathematical Models
